exclusions.source_text: Is 18 years of age or of the legal adult age per local standard at the time of signing the informed consent.
Has LVEF ≥ 50% as determined by either echocardiogram or MUGA obtained within 4 weeks before the first dose of study intervention.
Has ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Has creatinine clearance ≥ 50 mL/minute as calculated per local institutional guidelines.
A female participant is eligible to participate if she is not pregnant or breastfeeding, and one of the following conditions applies:
Has uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disease.
Has clinically confirmed leptomeningeal disease, in the opinion of the investigator.
Has an infection with HIV-1 or HIV-2, with the exception of participants with well-controlled HIV.
Female participants who are breastfeeding or pregnant, and female and male participants planning a pregnancy.
